what: the U3 logistic-regression heads on Axil's bge-small vector, as a matrix plus bias
input: Embedder::embed(text) with bge-small-en-v1.5 (the passage vector Axil stores for a record; for a stored record the text is util::searchable_text of its data)
rule: z = W v + b; p = softmax(z); predict classes[argmax p], or none when that class is not none and its probability < tau
parity: parity_fixtures give the Python probabilities for test texts of sets/u3_repo.jsonl; a Rust port must reproduce them from its own embedding of the same text

lr-weak.rule: softmax(W v + b); top class, or none when the top class is not none and its probability < tau

embedder.note: the embedder Axil already loads to store a record (axil-vector download.rs)
